_comment: Edit decisions for edit.mjs, trailer v4 ("Big Plays", 144 BPM: 25 frames per beat). Frame numbers are each cut's own (60 fps). The shot list is shots.mjs, the 15 s mapping is CUT15_SEGMENTS in mg-timeline.mjs, flashes/shakes/rgbashift/bumps come from post() there. Speed ramps are baked in at capture (real in-engine time scaling), so the edit never retimes footage.

grade._comment: Storyboard v2 §3: CAS 0.35; eq contrast 1.10, saturation 1.10; gentle S-curve; warm highlights; 16 % vignette; a highlight bloom (luma >= 0.82 keyed, gblur σ 18, added at 0.22) so skill FX glow on the sunny palette; grain 3. Type is composited after the grade. Redo: the bloom keys only the brightest highlights (>= 0.88) at 0.12, so pale plazas never wash out. v3: a highlight soft-clip in the S-curve (0.92 -> 0.88, 1 -> 0.94) and the bloom keys only >= 0.9 at 0.1, so white plazas, shockwave bands and hit flashes never blow out (<= 10 % of a frame at Y >= 235). v4: midtones down and a real toe (curves), near-white low-saturation areas pulled down (selectivecolor whites), the bloom keyed at >= 0.92 at 0.06, and the luma check (qc) fails a shot with more than 15 % of its picture at Y >= 225.

chroma._comment: rgbashift. strong (4 px) = post().rgb impact frames; light (2 px) = transition accents on the whip, the match cut and the big impacts.

push._comment: Digital push-ins: none. S19 is the gameplay camera 1:1 with its full HUD; S13's wheel and S14's bark are framed natively.

bump._comment: Zoom-punch (§3): 104 % scale-in over 3 frames, then out over 8 (the impact frames in post().bump).

band._comment: v3: none (the landscape HUD beat is 16:9 only; the 9:16 card-look shot runs on over it).

poster._comment: Thumbnails: Lambo at the top of the Belly Flop (S01 f2, side-on against the trees) with the logo and end-card lines from the 30 s overlay.

audio._comment: Mix from score.mjs stems: the music ducks under the sfx + game sounds (impacts), then glue, gain to -14 LUFS, a latency-free true-peak limiter, the end fade and digital silence.
audio._tp: the WAV must measure <= maxTruePeakWavDb so the AAC encode stays <= maxTruePeakDb
audio._sections: Energy curve v4 [from, to, dB] (8-frame ramps), before the limiter: a real arc. The hook and the ults chorus full, the roll call and 3V3 building under them, Pack Hunt held back (half-time), the groove back in from the ping, the two teamfight bars the loudest band, the tape-stop into near silence, the core burst the loudest hit, Victory and the end card under the teamfight.
audio._bed: v4: the music stem is limited at its own RMS + bedCrestDb (9 dB: drums keep their transients) before the mix; the sound effects between impacts at RMS + fxCrestDb.

headroom._comment: v4: the body is limited bodyDb under ceilingDb; the hook contact reaches ceilingDb + hookDb, the core burst ceilingDb + coreDb (the loudest transient; the AAC encode adds about 1.4 dB of true peak on it)

qc._comment: v4: per shot, the mean share of the picture at Y >= lumaY (8-bit, tv range) must stay at or under maxShare
